## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe
A clear and concise description of what problem you're experiencing with the Meta SDK training project. 

Examples:
- "I'm always frustrated when hand tracking doesn't work consistently in Module 3"
- "I find it difficult to understand how to implement passthrough in Module 5"
- "The current fruit slicing mechanic doesn't provide enough feedback for learning"

## Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen in the training project.

Examples:
- "Add visual feedback when hand tracking is properly initialized"
- "Include step-by-step tutorial for passthrough configuration"
- "Add haptic feedback when fruit is successfully sliced"

## Which training module does this affect?
- [ ] Module 1: Basic Setup
- [ ] Module 2: Environment Integration  
- [ ] Module 3: Hand Tracking
- [ ] Module 4: Object Interaction
- [ ] Module 5: Passthrough
- [ ] Module 6: Performance Optimization
- [ ] Multiple modules
- [ ] General/All modules

## Meta SDK Integration
How should this feature integrate with the Meta SDK?
- [ ] Hand Tracking (OVRHand/OVRSkeleton)
- [ ] Controller Input (OVRInput)
- [ ] Passthrough (OVRCamera)
- [ ] Haptics (OVRHaptics)
- [ ] Audio (OVRAudioSource)
- [ ] General Unity integration

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered for the training project.

Examples:
- "Using Unity's built-in hand tracking instead of Meta's implementation"
- "Creating custom visual indicators instead of using Meta's prefabs"
- "Implementing separate tutorial scenes instead of inline guidance"

## Training value
How would this feature improve the learning experience for Meta SDK development?

## Additional context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here:
- Specific exercise or scene
- Current implementation details
- Reference to Meta SDK documentation
- Mockups or examples
